text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув does her best at the Osaka
Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She reflects on the race as a stepping
stone to
challenging Сайленс Судзука at
the Takarazuka
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But even as she brims with the ambition
needed
to surpass Сайленс Судзука, there
is a somewhat
troubled expression on Air
Groove's face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
